reason: The README describes an Agent Skill whose primary user-facing purpose is generating, rendering, and visually reviewing Mermaid diagrams as normalized .mmd and high-resolution .png files.

summaries.zh: 为 AI Agent 生成、渲染并复检 Mermaid 图表，输出规范化源码和高清 PNG 文件。
summaries.en: A skill for AI agents that generates, renders, and visually reviews Mermaid diagrams as normalized source and high-resolution PNG files.

capabilities: Renders Mermaid diagrams to PNG images
Writes normalized source and rendered output files
Runs local Node.js setup and test commands
Performs SVG checks and optional visual review of PNG output
